name: Vashka the Red

Traits.name: Planted Stance
Traits.text: While Vashka has not moved since the end of his last turn, Vashka counts as wielding a shield for any ability that requires one, and the first time each round an effect would push, pull, or slide him, that movement is reduced to zero.
Traits.clause: Vashka's lacquered plate is drilled into his stance: while he has not moved since the end of his last turn, he counts as

Traits.name: Pack Tactics
Traits.text: Vashka has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of Vashka's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: Vashka makes two attacks, using Longsword or Longbow in any combination.

Actions.name: Longsword
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 21 (5d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Longbow
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 150/600 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

Reactions.name: Riposte
Reactions.text: *Trigger:* A creature within 5 feet of Vashka misses it with a melee attack roll. *Response:* Vashka makes one Longsword attack against that creature.

Bonus Actions.name: Close The Wall (2/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: Each ally within 30 feet of Vashka gains 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points.

lore: Vashka the Red earned his lacquered plate by never losing a formation, and he grinds lesser warbands into a disciplined empire of walls and drilled soldiers one battlefield at a time.

generation.userConcept: Vashka the Red — A hobgoblin warlord in lacquered plate who fights from a shield wall and never breaks ranks.
